description: This file defines data models and a fetcher class for TMX ETF search, including query parameters, data transformation, and data fetching logic.

classes.name: TmxEtfSearchQueryParams
classes.description: Defines query parameters for TMX ETF search, including dividend frequency, sorting options, and cache usage.

classes.name: TmxEtfSearchData
classes.description: Represents the data structure for TMX ETF search results, including various financial metrics and identifiers.

classes.name: TmxEtfSearchFetcher
classes.description: Handles transforming queries, fetching data from TMX endpoint, and converting raw data into structured models.

methods.name: transform_query
methods.description: Converts a dictionary of parameters into a TmxEtfSearchQueryParams instance.

methods.name: aextract_data
methods.description: Asynchronously fetches and processes ETF data from TMX, applying filters and sorting.

methods.name: transform_data
methods.description: Converts raw data dictionaries into structured TmxEtfSearchData models.
